'''Knox''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] living during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Alongside with his master, the [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]] [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] participated in the Republic's [[Devaron massacre/Legends|defense]] of the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. Though the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF troopers]] were initially successful in fighting off the Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], a [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|pupil]] of Separatist [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], turned the tide of the battle and cut through the Republic defenders. Both Knox and his master were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Zabrak [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. The Jedi's bodies were later recovered and [[Transport/Legends|transported]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|No!|Knox's last word, upon the death of Halsey|<ref name="Monster" />}}
[[File:KnoxDead-WOTM.png|thumb|left|200px|Knox lies dead at the hands of Savage Opress]]
Knox<ref name="MonsterGuide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep313|text="Monster" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Monster" /> [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]]<ref name="Clone Card: Knox" /> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Monster" /> Knox was selected to be a Padawan of<ref name="Clone Card: Knox" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="Magazine">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 4|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine'' 4]]</ref><ref name="Comic">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.19|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.19]]</ref> [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]].<ref name="MonsterGuide" /> Prior to or during the War, Knox built his blue [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Monster" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA2011" /> Knox and [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] fought in the [[Devaron massacre/Legends|Battle for the Temple of Eedit]] against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. The battle was in favor for the Republic but the sudden arrival of [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] turned the tide. Halsey ordered Knox to stay back from the fighting, and engaged Opress by himself, but proved no match for the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] and was brutally killed. After witnessing his master's [[Death/Legends|death]], Knox charged Opress, but the much stronger warrior slashed the Nautolan across the chest, throwing him headfirst at the front door and ending the Padawan's life.<ref name="Monster" /> Knox and his master's corpses were collected by [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commandos]] of the [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]].<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Knox's body re-uses [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal's]] geometry, but with newly textured finishes.<ref name="MonsterOldGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode313.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Monster}}</ref>
